name: Zoom
description: Optimized for Zoom - uses standard window flags for maximum compatibility
explanation: Zoom's screen sharing works best with standard application windows. This profile uses appwindow with layered style for clean rendering and topmost flag to prevent window occlusion during meetings. The window is sent to HWND_BOTTOM z-order while remaining fully opaque and visible. Zoom's window detection is very permissive, so this configuration ensures maximum compatibility.
